editions.notice: A machine translation made by this project with Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) on 18 November 2026, from Karl Müller's text of the fragments (Fragmenta Historicorum Graecorum IV, 1851). The fragments survive in the Excerpta de sententiis after Dio's; some scholars give them to Peter the Patrician. It is not a translator's work: check it against the Greek, and report errors.
